# Nafyad Dachasa (NafTech) — Official Tech, AI, Space & Web3 Creator Portfolio

> Nafyad Dachasa (Nafyad Dechasa Geleta, known online as Naf / NafTech) is a Computer Science graduate, AI researcher, and technology content creator based in Addis Ababa, Ethiopia. Through NafTech, he produces high-retention short-form and long-form videos covering artificial intelligence, software engineering, aerospace/space exploration, and Web3/blockchain for a combined audience of 214K+ followers across TikTok, Facebook, YouTube, and Instagram.

## Brand Sponsorship & Partnership Services
Nafyad partners with AI startups, Web3 platforms, fintech companies, hardware brands, and global tech ecosystems for sponsored video campaigns:
- **Single Video:** 1 research-backed, high-retention video with concept, script, and storytelling edit.
- **Mini Campaign (3 Videos):** Targeted multi-part campaign for steady product traffic.
- **Standard Campaign (5 Videos):** High-performance campaign engineered for leads and growth acceleration.
- **Premium (8 Videos/Month):** Dedicated monthly partnership with retention analytics and strategic planning.
- **Premium Plus (100 Videos/Year):** Long-term annual brand authority and dedicated playlist integration.
